hero.name: Pedro Suárez Gallardo
hero.pitch: I build the web products teams rely on: real-time, data-heavy and made to run in production.

about.statement: I build the parts that are hard to get right.

paragraphs.problem: Large data sets, live updates, complex forms, and state people can rely on. That is the work teams trust me with—and the work I enjoy most.
paragraphs.experience: I have more than three years of professional experience building and maintaining production web apps with React and TypeScript. I also work on the backend, building REST APIs in several languages and refactoring for speed and clarity.
paragraphs.approach: I understand the problem before I touch it, care about the details, and deliver software that stays maintainable. I use AI tools such as Copilot every day to move faster, and I always review what they produce.
paragraphs.background: I moved into web development through an intensive bootcamp and keep learning. Spanish is my native language.

desktopAppsToWeb.title: Desktop apps, moved to the web.
desktopAppsToWeb.result: I migrated two contact-center applications and redesigned their multilanguage interface. Both are in production and actively maintained.

liveSupervisionDashboard.title: A real-time supervision dashboard.
liveSupervisionDashboard.result: Tracks agent activity live, with customizable views and charts over hundreds of thousands of records.

adminSuite.title: An admin suite with dozens of sections.
adminSuite.result: Custom reporting, plus complex forms and tables with advanced validation.

visualFlowEditor.title: A visual flow editor.
visualFlowEditor.result: A workflow system for chatbots and voice menus (IVR), plus the frontend of a real-time live chat.

integrationsAndBackendApis.title: Integrations and backend APIs.
integrationsAndBackendApis.result: Messaging and CRM integrations through REST APIs and third-party SDKs, REST APIs in Node.js (Express), C# and PHP, Python automation, and backend refactors for speed and clarity.

javascript.name: JavaScript
javascript.description: JavaScript is a programming language used across the web. It powers interactive behavior in browsers and can also run outside them through runtimes such as Node.js.

typescript.name: TypeScript
typescript.description: TypeScript extends JavaScript with a static type system. It catches many mistakes during development and compiles to JavaScript.

react.name: React
react.description: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces from components. It updates the rendered interface as data and user input change.

nextJs.name: Next.js
nextJs.description: Next.js is a React framework for building web applications. It includes routing and supports server rendering, static generation and other rendering strategies.

html.name: HTML
html.description: HTML is the markup language that structures web content. Its elements describe headings, links, forms, media and other parts of a page.

css.name: CSS
css.description: CSS is the style language used to present web documents. It controls layout, typography, color, responsive behavior and visual states.

chartJs.name: Chart.js
chartJs.description: Chart.js is a JavaScript library for creating charts. It provides common chart types and options for responsive, interactive visualizations.

recharts.name: Recharts
recharts.description: Recharts is a charting library built with React components. Its composable charts use familiar React patterns to map data into visualizations.

nodeJs.name: Node.js
nodeJs.description: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime for applications and tools. It runs JavaScript outside the browser and provides APIs for server-side development.

expressJs.name: Express.js
expressJs.description: Express is a web framework for Node.js. Its routing and middleware APIs help structure HTTP servers and web APIs.

restApis.name: REST APIs
restApis.description: REST is an architectural style for networked applications that use HTTP. REST APIs expose resources through URLs and standard HTTP methods.

webSockets.name: WebSockets
webSockets.description: WebSocket is a protocol for a persistent, bidirectional connection between a client and server. It lets both sides exchange messages over one connection without repeated HTTP requests.

cSharp.name: C#
cSharp.description: C# is a statically typed, general-purpose programming language. It belongs to the .NET ecosystem and supports application development across platforms.

python.name: Python
python.description: Python is a general-purpose programming language with readable syntax. Its standard library and package ecosystem support scripting, automation, data work and web development.

mysql.name: MySQL
mysql.description: MySQL is a relational database management system. It stores structured data in tables and supports queries, relationships and transactions through SQL.

mongodb.name: MongoDB
mongodb.description: MongoDB is a document-oriented database. It stores records as JSON-like documents and supports flexible schemas, indexes and aggregation.

jest.name: Jest
jest.description: Jest is a JavaScript testing framework. It provides a test runner, assertions, mocks and utilities for running tests.

vitest.name: Vitest
vitest.description: Vitest is a testing framework designed to work with Vite. It offers a Jest-compatible API and uses Vite's transform and module-resolution pipeline.

playwright.name: Playwright
playwright.description: Playwright is a browser automation framework. It drives Chromium, Firefox and WebKit to test pages and end-to-end user flows.

githubActions.name: GitHub Actions
githubActions.description: GitHub Actions automates workflows for repositories. It can run jobs in response to events such as pushes, pull requests and scheduled triggers.

githubCopilot.name: GitHub Copilot
githubCopilot.description: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant integrated into development tools. It offers code completions and conversational help in supported editors and workflows.

claudeCode.name: Claude Code
claudeCode.description: Claude Code is an AI coding agent that works with software repositories. It can inspect files, make changes and run development commands through supported interfaces.

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.description: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent. It connects language models with tools for exploring, editing and running code in a development environment.

git.name: Git
git.description: Git is a distributed version control system. It records changes as commits and supports branching and merging across local and shared repositories.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: GitHub is a platform for hosting Git repositories and collaborating on software. It adds tools for code review, issue tracking and project automation.
